prj1_binding.detail: The PRJ-1 module freeze is being built in parallel on branch motif/prj1-freeze-2026-10-15. This FREEZE-1 does not touch that branch. The module + config sha256 hashes bind into the freeze record at FINAL. Composition authority: RULING-C1 §1 (landed and hashed above). RULING-C1 prerequisites: P1 satisfied on the record (ledger entry 0003); P2-P4 verify at the module freeze build.

bundle: (1) Freeze the future-filter scoring contract (SPEC-A) with the drafted defaults locked: T_emit = T-90 min; B = 10,000; alpha = 0.05 one-sided; power = 0.80; delta_min = 0.02; calibration = first 30% of the window by kickoff; abstention tau = 80th percentile of calibration interval widths; situational slots capped at 2; RVC-RED/AMBER/GREEN adopted.

(2) Adopt PRJ-1 as candidate #1 per RULING-C1, WITH the Grok WO-7 honesty amendments: the weekly joint CRPS fitting procedure (incl. nu selection) is part of the candidate procedure and multiplicity-covered (SPEC-A §8.5); the role rule is recorded as an engineering choice made after seeing F4's solo result, with F4/S-ALL4 promotable under a future pre-registered rule (RULING-C1 Amendment A1); the ceiling language is corrected — the solo-sum is an optimistic illustration under perfect additivity, not an upper bound (RULING-C1 Amendment A2).
(3) Decouple the product gate from the CRPS gate (SPEC-B §7.3 = YES): products gate on their own bettable metrics and on the product break-even bar when the break-even mapping lands.
